verify.note: auto: differential verify at every hook site (plotter entry + exit, diamond draw, 3 screen clears): all registers incl. AF', all memory outside the dead stack, interrupt safety per patched instruction while IFF is on (IX, IY, I, alternate set, SP, MMU6, no fetch at 0x3D00-0x3DFF); after every event the sprite layer = the Python model (objects as last plotted with their black mask, the pending image from entry to exit, the pair rule, the diamonds since the last clear, live inks / colour map); the plotter's screen change = old ^ new image of the model (every plot); while a plot runs (entry to exit) every pixel of the old and the new image under a visible sprite; the exit's (x, y, frame) = the entry's prediction; the diamond's 7 writes; every attribute read checked against the cells the removed painter leaves unpainted; the graphics never written; speed line. Unit cases: entry + exit for every frame 0-255 (moves with carries), exit alone (fallback) for every frame x edge positions, inks, pair rule, object guard, cache sequence, colour map with a wrong check byte, diamonds k 0-4 x positions + counter guard, clears; 7 negative controls (incl. the pending sprites not shown at the entry, the mask left out).
